"""The nightly report."""
import argparse
import glob
import os

from meridian import money
from meridian.regions import REGIONS


def total(region, month, feeds="feeds"):
    """Total one region's month across its feed files."""
    reader = REGIONS[region]["reader"]
    acc = 0
    for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(feeds, region, "*.csv"))):
        for row in reader(path):
            if row["date"].startswith(month):
                acc += row["amount"]
    return money.round_cents(acc)


def main(argv=None):
    """Print one region's monthly total."""
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="meridian report")
    p.add_argument("--region", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--month", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--feeds", default="feeds")
    a = p.parse_args(argv)
    print("%s %s" % (total(a.region, a.month, a.feeds), REGIONS[a.region]["currency"]))
    return 0

import unittest
from decimal import Decimal

from meridian import report
from meridian.ingest import apac, eu


class FeedParsingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def feed(self, content):
        directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(directory.cleanup)
        path = Path(directory.name) / "feed.csv"
        path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
        return path

    def test_eu_v2_amount_is_plain_decimal(self):
        path = self.feed(
            "# region: eu\n# format: v2\n"
            "date;account;amount\n2026-10-03;AC-3413;1425.01\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            eu.read_feed(path),
            [{"date": "2026-10-03", "account": "AC-3413", "amount": Decimal("1425.01")}],
        )

    def test_eu_v1_amount_keeps_grouped_decimal_comma(self):
        path = self.feed(
            "# region: eu\n# format: v1\n"
            "date;account;amount\n2026-09-27;AC-3239;4.014,05\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            eu.read_feed(path),
            [{"date": "2026-09-27", "account": "AC-3239", "amount": Decimal("4014.05")}],
        )

    def test_apac_v2_amount_is_plain_decimal(self):
        path = self.feed(
            "# region: apac\n# format: v2\n"
            "date|account|amount\n2026-10-11|AC-1381|2641.49\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            apac.load(path),
            [{"date": "2026-10-11", "account": "AC-1381", "amount": Decimal("2641.49")}],
        )

    def test_apac_v1_amount_keeps_space_grouped_decimal_comma(self):
        path = self.feed(
            "# region: apac\n# format: v1\n"
            "date|account|amount\n2026-09-02|AC-9426|1 114,82\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            apac.load(path),
            [{"date": "2026-09-02", "account": "AC-9426", "amount": Decimal("1114.82")}],
        )

    def test_unknown_format_is_rejected(self):
        path = self.feed(
            "# format: v9\ndate;account;amount\n2026-10-03;AC-3413;1425.01\n"
        )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "unsupported feed format"):
            eu.read_feed(path)

    def test_missing_format_is_rejected(self):
        path = self.feed("date;account;amount\n2026-10-03;AC-3413;1425.01\n")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "missing '# format:' header"):
            eu.read_feed(path)


class ReportTotalsTest(unittest.TestCase):

            region_dir = Path(feeds) / "eu"

            (region_dir / "2026-10.csv").write_text(

                "2026-10-03;AC-3413;1425.01\n"
                "2026-10-08;AC-1205;349.56\n",
